gates.name: git-preconditions
gates.script: bash -c commits=$(git log origin/main..HEAD --oneline 2>/dev/null | grep -c . || true); if [ "$commits" -gt 0 ]; then echo "FAIL: $commits unpushed commits"; exit 1; fi; dirty=$(git diff-index --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; echo $?); if [ "$dirty" -ne 0 ]; then echo "FAIL: dirty working tree"; exit 1; fi; echo "PASS: HEAD == origin/main, clean tree"
